Maya (support): Hey team — incoming escalation from customer ACME. They report tool/function-call args arriving as truncated JSON when we stream responses. Request ID: req_0a1b2c. Model: redwood-2. They see schema validation errors on our webhook: "Unexpected end of JSON". Customer says this is intermittent and correlates with ~200ms latency spikes.
Tony (eng-runtime): Can you paste the raw SSE output they received? Need to see chunk boundaries.
Maya (support): Pasting redacted SSE snippet from the customer's logs below (they replaced PII and token bytes):

```
event: message
data: {"role":"tool","name":"charge","arguments":"{\"amount\":1250,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"metadata\":{\"order_id\":\"ord_123\",\"user_id\":\"usr_"

--- next sse chunk ---

event: message
data: "456\",\"source\":\"web\"}}"

```
Maya (support): You can see the args string gets split in the middle of a quoted value (user_id) and the receiving webhook tried to validate the JSON and failed. Customer attached our webhook error: `schema validation failed: unexpected EOF while parsing value`
Carmen (oncall): That looks like a chunk reassembly issue on the client side or a proxy that splits SSE frames. Which SDK / proxy are they using?
Maya (support): They're using the JS SDK v0.9.1 behind Cloudflare spectrum load balancer (ks-prod LB). Also observed with direct curl from their infra occasionally.
Tony (eng-runtime): Two possible root causes: 1) model output legitimately contains the tool args across tokens and we stream token-by-token — client must reassemble the event stream correctly before parsing JSON. 2) intermediary (CF) is breaking event boundaries or injecting buffering that's causing clients to process partial events. We need raw server-side traces for req_0a1b2c. Maya can you request the raw event log from the customer (they already gave partial) and forward the proxy + SDK versions? Also include timestamp for when it happened.
Maya (support): I have timestamps and Cloudflare trace IDs. Sent to Tony in DM. Customer wants a mitigation now. Any temporary workaround?
Tony (eng-runtime): Workaround: disable streaming for function-calls on their client (use non-streaming generation) so we send final payload once. Or they can buffer SSE events and only call JSON.parse after reassembly. But for customer convenience, we should also verify server-side that we never emit events that split UTF-8 codepoints or JSON tokens mid-byte.
Carmen (oncall): Escalating to eng-runtime with priority P1 for an investigation and to confirm whether our event framing is guaranteed. Also flagging infra to check LB config for `proxy_buffering` and chunked transfer behavior.
DeployBot: New escalation ticket created: #SUP-3489. Linked runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3489
Tony (eng-runtime): Repro plan for eng: 1) Replay model output in a controlled local SSE emitter that splits output at arbitrary byte boundaries. 2) Test parsing with our JS SDK v0.9.1 and a minimal curl SSE consumer. 3) Run through our edge proxies (staging CF) to see if chunk splitting differs. 4) Check runtime code path that emits `data:` frames — ensure we don't break quoted strings mid-escape.
Tony (eng-runtime): Quick local repro I used: 
```
# mimic streaming model output with mid-chunk split
printf 'event: message\ndata: {"role":"tool","name":"charge","arguments":"{\\"amount\\":1250,\\"currency\\":\\"USD\\",\\"user_id\\":\\"usr_'
; sleep 0.2; printf '456\\",\\"meta\\":{}}"\n\n' | nc -l 9000
```
Tony (eng-runtime): That reproduces parsing errors if client does not reassemble. Also reproduced with `curl --no-buffer` hitting our staging SSE emitter.
Maya (support): Customer requests timeline. Can we give ETA to fix or will we recommend the non-streaming workaround?
Tony (eng-runtime): Short-term: advise non-streaming or SDK upgrade to v0.9.3 (which includes a small reassembly helper — push in 2 hours). I'll open PR for a server-side defensive fix to ensure `data:` frames don't break inside UTF-8 surrogates or escape sequences — but timeline is 3 days to review + canary.
Carmen (oncall): I'll notify the customer of recommended mitigations and that eng is on it. Maya, please collect: full request_id list, repro curl, exact SDK call they used, and the raw SSE they saved. We'll need them for postmortem.
Maya (support): Got it. I already sent the customer's raw snippet + CF trace IDs to the eng channel. Customer updated their callback to buffer events; they confirmed temporary fix works. I'll update ticket SUP-3489 and ping when we have a patch. :white_check_mark: 
Tony (eng-runtime): FYI — when you file the eng issue, include the model tokenization boundary tests and the SSE emitter script above. Also include a note about Cloudflare `http2` multiplexing interactions; those sometimes cause chunk coalescing differences.
Maya (support): Thanks. Closing loop with customer now.
Carmen (oncall): Adding post-incident checkbox: check SDK docs to call out that streaming requires event reassembly for function/tool args.
Maya (support): Noted. I'll draft a KB article after the fix.
Tony (eng-runtime): One more note — if SDK can't be upgraded quickly we can add a `stream_safe=true` query flag that disables in-flight chunking on our side (adds small latency), put that on the roadmap.
Maya (support): Ticket updated and customer ok with non-streaming temporary approach. Will follow up when eng posts PR.
